newsitem.title: FRANCE: Clergy, teachers snared in France paedophilia net.
newsitem.headline: Clergy, teachers snared in France paedophilia net.

text.p: Two clergymen and eight teachers were among 201 suspects being investigated by magistrates over child sex videos as France's biggest ever crackdown on paedophiles widened on Wednesday, police said.
Dozens more suspects were still in police custody awaiting questioning after more than 600 people were rounded up on Tuesday in raids to break up a network selling pornographic films involving boys.
"Searches are continuing. We're up to 611 this morning," a police source said.
Among those in custody was a 45-year-old Parisian man identified by police as the ringleader of the paedophilia network.
The man, whose name was not released, had been detained in an earlier paedophilia probe but released, police said.

Those being investigated were suspected of "handling images from the crime of corruption of minors aged under 15". Being placed under investigation under French law is short of an indictment but is a first step towards a trial.
Prosecutor Jean-Louis Coste said documents seized in the swoops provided evidence of seven cases of rape. One detainee was shown on a video raping four minors.
The raids followed 14 months of investigation which led the gendarmerie to a mail-order company in the central town of Macon selling pornographic films involving boys.

Tuesday's operation -- dubbed "Ado 71" after the French word for teenager and the car registration figure for the Macon region -- involved some 2,500 gendarmes across mainland France as well as on the French Caribbean islands of Martinique and Guadeloupe.
Gendarmes seized more than 350 pornographic cassettes which the company had bought outside of France, mainly in Spain and Poland, and then copied.
